items.title: 68004_Howard McGhee oral history interview
items.q: That's when I was with Lionel Hampton.

ctx.x: Yeah. Because somebody stole my mouthpiece. If it don't be for him, I would have been up shit creek, too. He made my mouthpiece for me in a day, and I... That's when I was with Lionel Hampton. I left my horn...
Oh, the two weeks at the Regal, right?
